formulas.total_costs_and_expenses: programming_and_production + marketing_and_promotion + other_operating_and_administrative + depreciation + amortization + goodwill_and_longlived_asset_impairments

revenue_yoy.description: Total revenue YoY growth rate vs Q-4

programming_and_production_margin_delta_.description: Programming and production as % of revenue, delta vs Q-4

marketing_and_promotion_margin_delta_bps.description: Marketing and promotion as % of revenue, delta vs Q-4

other_operating_and_administrative_margi.description: Other operating and administrative as % of revenue, delta vs Q-4

depreciation_margin_delta_bps.description: Depreciation as % of revenue, delta vs Q-4

amortization_margin_delta_bps.description: Amortization as % of revenue, delta vs Q-4

goodwill_and_longlived_asset_impairments.description: goodwill_and_longlived_asset_impairments absolute dollar value for the target quarter (predict the amount directly; 0 if none expected)

interest_expense_yoy.description: interest_expense YoY growth rate vs Q-4

investment_and_other_income_net_abs.description: investment_and_other_income_net absolute dollar value for the target quarter (predict the amount directly; 0 if none expected)

tax_rate.description: Effective GAAP tax rate for the target quarter (decimal, e.g. 0.14 = 14%; may be negative in a benefit quarter). Choose from the GAAP historical anchors provided; a discrete tax item can push it far from any of them.

shares_abs.description: shares: diluted weighted-average share count for the target quarter (predict the count directly; drifts slowly with buybacks/issuance).

net_income_abs.description: net_income absolute dollar value for the target quarter (below-pretax line; predict directly, 0 if none expected).

net_income_attributable_to_noncontrollin.description: net_income_attributable_to_noncontrolling_interests absolute dollar value for the target quarter (below-pretax line; predict directly, 0 if none expected).
